name: Smart Product Gallery for FluentCart
author: ShapedPlugin LLC

sections.description:
Smart Product Gallery for FluentCart transforms your FluentCart product pages with a fast, responsive, and fully customizable product image gallery. Replace the default gallery with a professional image slider that includes thumbnail navigation, image zoom, and a built-in lightbox — all configured from an easy, no-code settings panel.

It works automatically on your FluentCart single product pages and inside the “View Options” quick-view popup, so your customers always get the enhanced gallery experience.

Features

  • Thumbnails Bottom & Top layouts for the product image slider.
  • Smooth image slider with autoplay, speed control, infinite loop, and slide/fade effects.
  • Thumbnail navigation with Outer and Inner Right styles, custom sizes, spacing, borders, and hover effects.
  • Navigation arrows with customizable icon, size, colors, and radius.
  • Pagination with Bullets, Dynamic, and Strokes styles plus color options.
  • Image zoom with Default and Inside (2x) styles.
  • Built-in lightbox with slideshow, thumbnails, fullscreen, download, and counter controls.
  • Product variation support — gallery images update with the selected variation.
  • Responsive design that looks great on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • No-code settings panel with live, organized controls (General, Gallery, Zoom, Lightbox, Advanced).
  • Per-tab reset to quickly restore a tab’s settings to their defaults.
  • Custom CSS field for advanced styling.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure the free FluentCart plugin is installed and active.
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smart-product-gallery-for-fluentcart directory, or install the plugin through the Plugins > Add New screen in WordPress.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  4. Go to FluentCart > Product Gallery to configure the gallery.
  5. Visit any product page to see your gallery in action.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require FluentCart?

Yes. FluentCart must be installed and active for the gallery to work. The plugin automatically replaces FluentCart’s default product gallery.

Where do I configure the gallery?

After activation, open the Product Gallery settings page from the FluentCart > Product Gallery. All options are organized into tabs with live controls.

Does the gallery work in the quick-view “View Options” popup?

Yes. The enhanced gallery is rendered both on single product pages and inside FluentCart’s quick-view modal.

Is it compatible with product variations?

Yes. When a customer selects a variation, the gallery filters to show that variation’s images.

Can I add the gallery with a shortcode?

Yes. Use [smart_product_gallery] to render the gallery manually (for example, in a page builder layout).
